name: PD 293 was established by Ordinance No. 19922, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 13,
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 293 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-293.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 293 was established by Ordinance No. 19922, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 13, 1988. Ordinance No. 19922 amended Ordinance Nos. 10962 and 19455, Chapters 51 and 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19455; 19922; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-293.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 293 is established on property generally located at the southeast corner of Illinois Avenue and Vernon Avenue. The size of PD 293 is approximately 2.176 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19922; 25711; 26748)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-293.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-293.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 293A). (Ord. Nos. 19922; 25711; 26748)

sections.title: Use
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-293.105. USE.

The only uses permitted on the Property are a fire station, a public park, and single family residential uses. (Ord. Nos. 19922; 25711)

sections.title: Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-293.106. FLOOR AREA.

Maximum permitted floor area for a fire station use on the Property is 12,330 square feet. A maximum of 10 single family residential dwelling units are permitted on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 19922; 25711; 26748)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-293.107. SETBACKS.

Minimum setbacks on the Property are provided on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 19922; 25711)

sections.title: Heights
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-293.108. HEIGHTS.

Except for a 45-foot communication tower and a 60-foot pole with a civil defense siren, maximum height on the Property is 30 feet. (Ord. Nos. 19922; 25711)

sections.title: Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-293.109. COVERAGE.

Maximum coverage on the Property is 43 percent. Parking structures are not included in the calculation of lot coverage. (Ord. Nos. 19922; 25711)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-293.110. PARKING.

Off-street parking must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 19922; 25711)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-293.111. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 293B). All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 19922; 25711; 26748)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-293.112. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 19922; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-293.113. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Use of the Property must comply with the requirements of all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19922; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-293.114. PAVING.

(a) All parking spaces, aisles, maneuvering areas, and driveway connections must be surfaced to comply with the standards set forth in the Dallas Development Code.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 19922; 25711)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-293.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19922; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-293.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 293 is located on Zoning Map No. M-6. (Ord. Nos. 19922; 25711)
